item.title: Uttar Pradesh Intermediate Education Act, 1921 | Re-evaluation of answer-sheets cannot be ordered merely on student’s expectation of higher marks: Allahabad High Court
item.description: Ground for challenge was that she performed and fared so well and excellent in all subjects including Hindi and Biology of Intermediate Examination 2025 that she was expecting and assessing herself to achieve at least 90 marks in Hindi and 96 marks in Biology. The post Uttar Pradesh Intermediate Education Act, 1921 | Re-evaluation of answer-sheets cannot be ordered merely on student’s expectation of higher marks: Allahabad High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Malaysian Bar Council Issues Updated Publicity Rules 2025 for Lawyers
item.description: Malaysia announces Legal Profession Publicity Rules 2025 to regulate ethical publicity by lawyers effective from January 2026. The post Malaysian Bar Council Issues Updated Publicity Rules 2025 for Lawyers appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi High Court grants Ex-parte injunction protecting Actor Junior NTR’s Personality Rights
item.description: The grievance of the plaintiff arose from the manufacture, sale, promotion, and distribution of merchandise such as T-shirts, posters, mugs, keychains, and other products bearing his name, photographs, likeness, and persona, without authorisation. The post Delhi High Court grants Ex-parte injunction protecting Actor Junior NTR’s Personality Rights appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Chhattisgarh High Court upholds divorce due to cruelty by wife who concealed her infertility
item.description: The Court noted that the wife admitted in her written statement and oral testimony that after taking medication she had become capable of bearing children. The post Chhattisgarh High Court upholds divorce due to cruelty by wife who concealed her infertility appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Buyer cannot reject goods after use; Bombay HC upholds ₹4.25 crore Arbitral award against Godrej & Boyce
item.description: “The Tribunal conducted a factual inquiry, relying on quality certificates, mill test reports, IGC test results, and inspection reports of the third-party agency, all of which confirmed that the tubes supplied by the respondent was in accordance with the requisite specifications. Once this was established, the burden shifted to the petitioner to prove defects.” The post Buyer cannot reject goods after use; Bombay HC upholds ₹4.25 crore Arbitral award against Godrej & Boyce appeared first on SCC

item.title: [Judicial Services Exam] Bombay HC permits candidates to inspect answer books to ensure fairness; rules out re-evaluation of marks
item.description: “The sanctity of the competitive examination is to be maintained, and a writ cannot be issued to satisfy every doubt of the aggrieved candidate.” The post [Judicial Services Exam] Bombay HC permits candidates to inspect answer books to ensure fairness; rules out re-evaluation of marks appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: AI Deepfakes to Trademark Wars: The Biggest Digital, Tech and IPR Stories of 2025

item.title: Aadhaar authentication compulsory for NMNF benefits; Farmers to receive ₹4,000 per acre annually for 2 years
item.description: Agriculture Ministry mandates Aadhaar authentication for farmers to access benefits under NMNF Scheme, ensuring transparency and efficient delivery of ₹4,000 per acre incentive.
